about: E106: every refusal code a later, expensive stage can raise (test_refusal_parity.LATER), with its class: A predicted early by the same function or constant (`early`: path::needle), B a rework hole (`early`: the cheap check that would catch it, `open`: why it is still open), C knowable only after a generation, voice or render (`probe`: the cheapest earlier probe), D external or transient (`resume`), I an engine invariant no plan can break (`guard`), N not a refusal (`why`). `was`: B means the hole was closed by E106. A new later-stage code fails migration/ops/test_refusal_parity.py until it is classified here.

review.about: E106 (owner, 2026-10-26: "Production has to come out at 9.5 already; the review only confirms. Never produce loosely and fix it later."): every item the review scores and every row it relies on, mapped to the earlier check that guarantees it. class plan (plan_check / long_plan_check / script_check), preflight, build_gate (episode_build, short_engine, clip_check, lipsync_check, still-mouth, LUFS), render_qa (the frozen QA on the render; earlier only by estimate), open (no earlier check yet: `reason`), review_only (no tool can measure it: `reason`). `checks` are path::needle, each held by its file (test_refusal_parity). `residual`: what the review still has to see.

short.residual: whether the first spoken line lands as a conflict is a judgement on the words; plan_check fixes its form (a character's or God's line from 0 s, never the Keeper or narration first)

long.residual: the preview review of the real opening (preview_gate) before the 2.5 h render

short.residual: AI artifacts in a generated frame (a hand, a face, a stray mark) and the painterly finish: no tool measures them; the 20-frame sheet of the composed file is where they are seen

long.residual: AI artifacts in a generated frame (a hand, a face, a stray mark) and the painterly finish: no tool measures them; the 20-frame sheet of the composed file is where they are seen
